title: Foreground launcher-stage lookup reads the last `results:` line of a summary, which a stage-log excerpt can displace, leaving a passed gate uncredited
outcome: Foreground launcher-stage lookup reads the last `results:` line of a summary, which a stage-log excerpt can displace, leaving a passed gate uncredited
acceptance: The foreground lookup of a launcher run's request record uses the launcher's own `results:` line (the first one, or the one right after the PASS/FAIL verdict line), not the last; a test where a later diagnostics excerpt line starts with `results: ` shows the gate still credited.
